cli.alphaPinSource: alpha apps/portal/src/lib/benchmark-packages.ts at this branch's head — a different pin, not used in stage 1
cli.twoPinNote: plan #108 correction: stage 1 uses beta's staging pin; stage 3 tests both pins in both directions
cli.install: pip install from a local git worktree at 064400e9cf65874b87fe888fc6fd14a564095c5e (commit present in this repo's history; no network install)
cli.benchmarkIdSource: the chosen week's pyproject cogworks.benchmarks.v1/v2 entry point (check/run take plugin ids, not directory names)

measurement.d1StatementsPerRequest: x-upgrade-suite-queries response header via the countD1Proxy shim (kept)

workerCpu.reason: no workerd CPU telemetry in this run (the vite-plugin dev server exposes no CPU accounting); performance.now wall time is not Worker CPU and is not reported

method: All state created through beta's real paths: POST /api/dev/login with generated upg-* handles only; /api/cohorts/join (code VISION26); /api/github/connect with the fixture repo (creates the one fork-provenance team); /api/team/join for self-serve joins; /api/admin/staff for staff rostering (owner PLATFORM_OWNER_LOGINS in .dev.vars); TA assignment attempted via /api/admin/teams/:id/tas and recorded as unreachable (it matches users.github_login, which dev-auth accounts never hold; rostered staff still sign in so their user rows exist); /api/runs/practice, /api/runs/:id and /api/runs/:id/promote for hosted fixture runs and published official attempts; the pinned staging CLI (beta's benchmark-packages.ts COGBENCH_SOURCE pin) linked via /api/v1/cli/device/* and produced local reports with cogworks run --live, cogworks run + cogworks sync against real public week data (benchmarks/week* submodule, its benchmark package pip-installed and the plugin id taken from its pyproject entry points). No real student handles or submissions anywhere; no discord.com, no real GitHub OAuth, no Modal, no dev/prod Workers/D1/R2.
quirks: one team per (cohort, repository): the fixture repo supports exactly one connect-created team per cohort, and demo:true logins converge onto it
joining the seeded (non-fixture) teams requires a real GitHub token, so dev-auth users can only ever occupy the fixture-repo team
device approval requires an on-team session (requireTeam), so devices link after team joins

dev-auth accounts never hold users.github_login (nulled on every dev login; reserved for real GitHub identities), so member add/remove and TA assignment routes that match on it are unreachable in dev-auth mode
fixture runs advance on read by wall clock (~21s end to end); promotion requires the parent practice run to have succeeded

beta's worker never writes official_attempts in this flow (no runtime code touches the table; the seeded demo attempt stays consumed by the seed itself), and the designed practice-mode failure never promotes, so no refund fires - the bar pins zero new attempts and zero refunds and measures promotion via officialRuns deltas instead
